web.title: Front-end Developer
summary: I am a front-end developer with 10+ years of experience building production web applications with React and TypeScript. Have contributed to high-traffic platforms and Web3 solutions. Experienced in building and maintaining component libraries across product teams and startups. I use AI-assisted tooling for scaffolding, refactors, code review, and architecture research.
I am excited about contributing to creative passion-driven projects. I enjoy creating scroll-driven animations and interactive 3D experiences.
